target.description: Position of the luminous flame front after the cutoff, in the camera plane a metric calibration defines: the front contour f(s, t) on the transverse grid of the admitted contours, and its spatial mean with an assumed spread.
excludes: any forecast from pixel-only contours (no metric calibration, no metric target)
temperature, heat flux, species or soot inferred from image intensity
the pyrolysis or char front (the camera sees luminous emission)
extinction or flammability limits (a front leaving view is not an extinction)
effects of oxygen, flow, pressure or thickness: no metric run exists to support one
a calibrated posterior: the spread is assumed

features.name: a_m
features.transform: cosine-mode amplitudes of the last usable contour: trapezoid integral of f * phi_m over xi @1

features.name: v_m
features.transform: (mean a_m over the last window - mean over the window before it) / (difference of their mean times); windows span enc.window_frac of the prefix duration each @1

features.name: lead
features.transform: t - time of the last usable contour @1

tensors.name: op.gain
tensors.description: Fraction of each mode's observed velocity that the forecast carries.

tensors.name: op.persist_s
tensors.description: Time over which each mode's carried drift persists (large = steady spread).

tensors.name: op.damp_per_s
tensors.description: Relaxation rate of each mode's amplitude (front smoothing).

tensors.name: unc.sigma_m
tensors.description: Assumed sd of the measured mean front position at zero lead.

tensors.name: unc.rel_v
tensors.description: Assumed relative sd of the carried mean velocity.

tensors.name: unc.sigma_v_m_s
tensors.description: Assumed absolute sd of the mean velocity, whatever its size.

tensors.name: enc.window_frac
tensors.description: Each velocity window spans this fraction of the prefix duration.

tensors.name: enc.min_frames
tensors.description: Fewest usable contours for a forecast.

tensors.name: enc.max_missing_frac
tensors.description: Largest fraction of unresolved nodes of a usable contour.

tensors.name: num.max_lead_s
tensors.description: Longest lead time after the last usable contour.

notes: Usable contour: status single_valued, the transverse grid of the last admitted contour, unresolved nodes at most enc.max_missing_frac (filled by linear interpolation along s, nearest value at the ends). A contour whose derivation notes say UNCALIBRATED or pixel, or that names no calibration, makes the prefix unusable: the forecast is refused, never rescaled. Spread of the mean front: sqrt(sigma_m^2 + (rel_v |gain_0 v_0| + sigma_v)^2 lead^2), Gaussian. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
